_: Known, reasoned exceptions for tools/overlap-audit.js. Each entry: kind, sel (substring of either selector), optional scenario / width / with, and a reason. No reason, no exception.

allow.reason: Files panel: the trailing Add button sits over the row's right end by design; the row's meta fades out under it on hover and the row reserves 40px for it on the phone
Tool rows (desktop): the copy button appears over the row's right end on hover / keyboard focus by design; the time and flag step 26px aside for it, and the phone hides it

Menu and palette rows show keyboard position as the row highlight (.active / aria-selected, the same surface as :focus-visible); only the already-highlighted row can be reported, and it is already marked
Files search: the magnifier glyph sits inside the field by design (pointer-events: none; the input pads 26px for it)
Sliders draw the focus ring on ::-webkit-slider-thumb (dark and light), which the probe's computed-style signature cannot read
